nodes.label: Meeting Room Photo 2 – La Nube Polo Tecnológico
nodes.description: Interior photograph of a small-to-medium meeting room at La Nube Polo Tecnológico. The room features a rectangular wooden conference table surrounded by approximately 6–8 white ergonomic mesh-back office chairs. A large flat-screen display mounted on the wall shows the 'La Nube Polo Tecnológico' branding logo (brain/cloud icon). A video-conferencing camera bar sits atop the display. A laptop and tablet/document holder are placed on the table. The room has glass partition walls with black metal frames, offering visibility into an adjacent corridor and open coworking area. A wooden/OSB-panel door is visible to the right. White tile flooring. Bright, modern aesthetic. This is a second angle of the meeting room resource, complementing meeting.jpg, likely showing the room from the opposite end (looking toward the glass partition and exit rather than the wall).
